name: NPTEL
provider: IITs and IISc (Ministry of Education, Govt of India)
level: Class 12 pass, college students and working professionals
cost: Free to learn; an optional proctored exam gives a certificate for a fee (check the site)
what: Over 2500 free online video courses across engineering, science, management and humanities. The certificate is recognised by many colleges and recruiters.
eligibility: Open to anyone; no entry requirement

name: SWAYAM
provider: Ministry of Education, Govt of India
level: Class 9 to postgraduate, and working professionals
cost: Free to learn; a small optional fee for a proctored certificate. Some courses carry academic credit.
what: The government's national MOOC platform, hosting courses from IITs, IGNOU, UGC and NCERT — from school level up to postgraduate — in many subjects.

name: Skill India Digital Hub
provider: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
what: A government platform for free, job-ready skill courses across sectors like IT, AI and trades, with digital certificates and links to apprenticeships and jobs.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
level: Youth, including those who left formal education
cost: Free short-term skill training with certification
what: The flagship free skill-training scheme: hands-on vocational training, an industry-recognised certificate, and placement support.

name: DIKSHA
what: The national school platform with textbooks, video lessons and practice aligned to CBSE and state boards, available in many Indian languages.

name: National Career Service (NCS)
what: A government portal for job listings, free career counselling, and links to skill training and apprenticeships.
